$comment: Hard npm-tarball budgets against the measured pre-8.0.0 baseline. Packed and unpacked ceilings are set from current measurements with 5% headroom, then ratchet downward when real reductions land; an unmet fixed reduction target would leave the gate permanently red. Ratcheted forward once already: a broad accessibility/correctness remediation sweep across roughly five dozen components (the same sweep that required re-budgeting the packed-consumer core bundle check) grew the measured package to 6,630,349 packed / 28,329,498 unpacked bytes and 3,115 files, past the prior ceilings. The file ceiling is the prior 2,500-artifact limit plus two emitted files for each of 284 stable lr-* alias entries (283 -> 284: one new component) and 72 files of entrypoint headroom (34 -> 72: the remainder of the measured growth, not attributable to the alias count alone); explicit source/map rejection remains independent.
